profile.headline: I'm driven and passionate about helping companies build and maintain clean code
profile.summary: Appnio Inc. is an ambitious company driven by integrity and built on a foundation of passion, talent and drive. At Appnio we strive to bring forth clean, efficient software that provides the best user experience on the market while maintaining close and personable relationships with both client and customer. We are, above all, devoted to providing the best experiences for client and customer alike both in software and in relations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a senior software engineer at Facebook, I was tasked with many complex and challenging problems with my responsibilities working on the Feed Experience Consumption team.  My responsibilities were vast and included but were not limited to architecting software solutions used at scale by billions of people as well as implementing them, driving progress and innovation towards team goals by presenting a constant stream of ideas for improvement of the main Facebook feed that had impact towards team goals, analyzing complex metrics and data for verification of results or debugging problems, led teams of engineers by providing tasks and direction, improving legacy systems and refactoring to ensure optimal efficiency across performance and cost to company.

positions.title: President
positions.description: As CEO of Appnio I'm tasked with managing client relations and developing clean, robust software

positions.title: Lead Android Developer / Consultant
positions.description: As the lead consultant android developer for Pixegon, I architected complex software solution, implemented, designed and tested several applications for clients including, but not limited to, Intel, Faith comes by hearing, and the Albuquerque Journal.

positions.title: Consultant Senior Android Engineer
positions.description: I was brought in, in a last push effort to get their current project to delivery on schedule

projects.title: Digital Bible Platform
projects.description: To reach people with God's Word in the midst of this digital age, Faith Comes By Hearing created the Digital Bible Platform, which includes the world's largest standardized digital library of Bible text, audio and video recordings. The Digital Bible Platform makes the Bible available to people around the world through Internet, social networks, podcasts, streaming, celestial and terrestrial radio broadcasts as well as mobile apps, SMS, POTS and satellite TVs. Users in nearly every country in the world are accessing God's Word in their own language — all at no cost to the user.

projects.title: NFL Mobile
projects.description: I was brought in early 2015 for the rewrite/relaunch of NFL mobile.  I spent almost 5 years working on this project and my contributions were vast.  During my time I had managed a team as large as 22 and as small as 4. In 2018 when the decision to rewrite in react native was made, I continued work in both js and native kotlin.
